title: Artifact Acceptance Conveyor: deterministic transform, runtime-compat certs, and canonical pin publish
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an end-to-end pipeline that accepts community weights, performs deterministic conversion and normalization, validates runtime compatibility across target runtimes, generates a canonical immutable pin, and publishes a performance profile to the model catalog. The conveyor must produce reproducible artifacts (bit-identical pins when conversion path unchanged), a runtime compatibility matrix, and telemetry for quality/regression detection. Goals: (1) deterministic weight transforms (conversion + quantization metadata preservation), (2) automated functional & perf smoke validation on minimal footprint clusters, (3) safe pin publication with staged rollouts and automated rollback on regressions, (4) clear audit trail (who approved, what conversion flags, CVs), (5) minimal manual triage for common OSS weight shapes. Out of scope: full large-scale benchmarking (handled by separate perf lab job).
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline ingests weight bundles from S3 or GitHub release and records provenance (URL, checksum, uploader)
Deterministic conversion step produces identical byte-level pin for same input + flags; deterministic seed/ordering documented
Automated runtime-compat checks against runtime-1.18 and runtime-1.20 kernels; compatibility matrix published
Profile publish includes latency P50/P95 (small sample), tokenization parity checks, and a QC pass/fail flag
Canary publish flow: pin published to 'staging' catalog + smoke traffic; automatic revert if perf regressions exceed threshold
Audit log entry created with PK for every publish and approval recorded; must be queryable from Console

2025-02-27: Implemented compatibility checker that runs canonical small-run inference on runtime-1.18 and runtime-1.20 images; discovered kernel mismatch for fused-scaling op in model-X leading to degraded P95 on runtime-1.20
2025-03-03: Rolled out deterministic ordering patch and canonical serializer; added explicit conversion flags for quantization provenance. Preparing canary publish for two community models.
